## v0.5.54 · Optional memory snapshot freezing and reliable idle reviews / 可选记忆快照冻结与可靠的闲时复盘

### English

- Runtime Memory can freeze the initial snapshot in an open conversation to keep its prompt prefix stable through routine memory updates. New conversations and explicit memory tools read current data. Permission or scope changes retire affected snapshots, and DSH compaction refreshes them. The default refreshes the snapshot when memory changes. ([#732](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/732))
- Idle memory review starts correctly with DSH Auto Review enabled. DSH still applies its tool permissions and review decisions to background memory writes. ([#730](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/730))
- Text-only skill drafting, review, and evaluation use scoped read-only tools with native presentation on supported hosts. ([#729](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/729))

### 简体中文

- 开启会话快照冻结后，常规记忆更新会保留已打开会话的提示词前缀。新会话和显式记忆工具读取最新内容。权限或范围变化时清理受影响的旧快照，DSH 压缩后刷新快照。默认按记忆变化刷新。([#732](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/732))
- DSH 开启 Auto Review 时，闲时记忆复盘可以正常启动。后台写入仍受 DSH 工具权限和审阅结果约束。([#730](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/730))
- 纯文本技能草案、复盘和评测在限定范围内使用只读工具，宿主支持时使用原生工具呈现。([#729](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/729))

Update from **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then fully restart DSH. / 在**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**中升级，然后完整重启 DSH。
